commentary.text: 90+7' Alejandro Ruiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
90+2' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a yellow card.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90' Here is a change. Sergio Gomez is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
90' Wonderful movement by Rayo Vallecano. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
88' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
85' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle as Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
84' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
83' The attendance for today's match is 12364.
81' The game is interrupted now, Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

80' 2 - 2 Goal! Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Augusto Batalla is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:2.
78' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Ruiz no option but to blow his whistle.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Ander Olasagasti leaves the pitch and Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) comes on.
76' Substitution. Pedro Diaz makes his way off the pitch and Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as his replacement.
76' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Jorge de Frutos will be replaced by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
76' It will be a substitution. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to enter the pitch as Pathe Ciss walks off.
75' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
74' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is booked.

72' 2 - 1 What a goal! Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes into the bottom left corner and behind the goalkeeper.

71' Rayo Vallecano are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

69' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
68' Etienne Eto'o (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.

66' Real Sociedad slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
64' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
63' Substitution. Orri Oskarsson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
63' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) replaces Ander Barrenetxea.
62' Here comes a substitution. Oscar Trejo is given a rest as he is replaced by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
60' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) will miss the next game.
58' 1 - 1 Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alex Remiro with a strike into the top right corner. He makes it 1:1.
57' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Etienne Eto'o (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Sergio Guardiola.
55' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
52' Augusto Batalla displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

51' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alex Remiro makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
51' Wonderful movement by Rayo Vallecano. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
48' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
47' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Imanol Alguacil gives a chance to Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) and Javi Lopez is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
40' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
40' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

39' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the top left corner, but Augusto Batalla made an astonishing save! The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
37' Real Sociedad are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
34' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
33' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
31' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
28' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
26' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
24' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).
23' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.

20' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Sergio Gomez delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is lurking. His precise shot from close range goes into the bottom right corner and it's 0:1.
20' Corner kick. Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is ready to send the ball into the box.

17' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
15' A long ball forward to Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
14' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

12' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
11' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
9' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.

8' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Rayo Vallecano are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
6' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a chip pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla is quickest to intercept the ball.
2' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
